system.description: At a location important to the deceased, call a ghost through offerings of grave goods and fresh blood. Difficulty -1 in a shadowland or Underworld; +1 per 100 years dead; +1 if summoning by qualities rather than name. In a shadowland, failure summons five unwelcome ghosts per success short of the roll. Summoned ghost manifests visibly but remains immaterial unless it can materialize on its own or the summoning occurs in a shadowland.
